assumptions: Fix applies one pinned buyer-trust run to the repository that serves that site.
Source-only contribution: growth.buyer_trust and growth.trust_fix must be registered together; merging source alone does not activate either workflow.
Static hosts and header configs only; no framework build or payment logic changes.
effects: Opens one unmerged GitHub PR plus a run receipt in this project.
cost_drivers: Number of Fix now items applied, within the three-file change budget.

rubric.question: Does the receipt cite the pinned audit run and exact files changed?
Does the change stay within headers, security.txt, and footer copy without widening scope?

cases.description: Apply Fix now headers and footer links to the connected repository.
Unsupported host returns an explicit no-change report instead of a PR.

inputs.context: Managed host without header config; do not widen scope.
